name: E. E. Ball
role: Mandan dentist making visits to Medora
bio: E. E. Ball, a Mandan dentist, advertised visits to Medora in June 1884, which he put off because of illness. He came in November 1884, setting up at John O'Sullivan's barber shop.

mentions: Dr E. E. Ball, of Mandan, will be in Medora June 9, 10 and 11; prepared to do all kinds of dentistry. It will be a good opportunity to "have it pulled."

E. E. Ball, of Mandan, a first-class dentist, will be here the last three days of next week to do any work in his line that may be required by our citizens.
Dr. E. E. Ball, of Mandan, arrived in town last evening, and is located at Mr. John O' Sullivan's barber shop. Persons desiring dental work should not fail to see him.
